verification.renderedHtml: All listed routes returned HTTP 200 during exact-head preview validation; representative metadata and content were inspected.
verification.canonicalMetadata: Infrastructure routes, pricing and checkout expose route-specific canonical metadata.
verification.responsive: Responsive source was inspected at the declared 1180px, 860px and 560px breakpoints. No remote screenshot-capable browser was available in this release toolchain.
verification.accessibility: Semantic headings, skip link, form labels, aria-live output, focus-visible handling and reduced-motion handling are present.
verification.commerceBoundary: B2B checkout is invoice-led and contract-first until a reviewed payment URL is configured. It does not imply hardware, finance or production authority.

knownLimitations: The reference workspace uses explicitly labelled sample data, not client telemetry.
NEXT_PUBLIC_POLAR_INFRASTRUCTURE_BLUEPRINT_URL is not configured; checkout uses an invoice-led engagement intake.
No client operational database, ERP connector credentials, energy telemetry, bank facility or production agent tenant is provisioned in this public reference release.
The public contract structures are issue maps and decision frameworks, not executable legal, tax, credit, insurance or energy-market advice.
Vercel preview deployments are noindex; production-domain indexing is verified separately after merge.
No remote screenshot-capable browser was available; rendered HTML, metadata, responsive source and build output were inspected.
